measurementMethod: Dark-component silhouette profile (analysis/measure3.py), skin colour-band locator (analysis/measure4.py) and eye-white blob locator (analysis/measure7.py) on the 2000x1125 sheet. All pixel values in sheet coordinates; the front view is centred on x=426.

proportions.notes: Head unit measured on the head+hair block (crown 165 to chin 488). The twin-tail spikes rise above the crown to y=123 and are excluded from the head unit. Legs are deliberately short (0.84 HU) and shoulders narrow relative to the head (0.75 HU < head width 369px) - both are chibi traits, not measurement error.

pose.type: standing A-pose, symmetric, weight evenly distributed, feet slightly apart and parallel
pose.angleConvention: degrees, z-component is abduction away from the body midline, read off the front view silhouette

faceLandmarks.normalisation: fractions of the head+hair bounding box x[240..609] y[165..488]

eyeGeometry.style: blank white sclera, no visible iris or pupil, enclosed by a thick black limbal ring ~8px wide
eyeGeometry.asymmetry: the +X (character's left, screen right) eye is partly occluded by a fringe lock; its visible width measures 52px against 69px - preserve this, it is in the reference

features.name: blocky faceted hair shell with lateral ear-cup slabs
bare thighs between shorts and boot tops
long twin-tails terminating at y~810, above the boot tops
features.evidenceRef: front-view silhouette width collapse at y=838

authoringInstruction: Measured values above replace the extract_landmarks.py placeholders. Face landmarks are normalised to the head+hair bounding box, so eyeLine sits low (0.78) because the hair mass occupies the upper 60% of that box; this is the observed value, not a default.
